mil3.1.8:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of application of mind, and what is the characteristic of wisdom?”
mil3.1.8:1.3: “Application of mind, Great King, has the characteristic of taking hold; wisdom has the characteristic of cutting.”
mil3.1.8:2.1: “How does application of mind have the characteristic of taking hold, and how does wisdom have the characteristic of cutting?
mil3.1.8:2.5: “How, Great King, do barley-reapers reap the barley?”
mil3.1.8:2.6: “Venerable sir, they take a bundle of barley in the left hand, take a sickle in the right hand, and cut with the sickle.”
mil3.1.8:3.1: “Just as, Great King, a barley-reaper takes a bundle of barley in the left hand, takes a sickle in the right hand, and cuts the barley;
mil3.1.8:3.2: in the same way, Great King, a practitioner takes hold of the mind with application of mind and cuts off the defilements with wisdom. That, Great King, is how application of mind has the characteristic of taking hold, and how wisdom has the characteristic of cutting.”
